caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile sample with a braided border at the bottom. The textile consists of four main vertical sections: the left-most section is a narrow multicolored stripe with shades of red, yellow, green, and purple; the second section is the widest, composed of light brown and beige interwoven strands; the third section is a narrow, multicolored stripe similar to the first; and the fourth section, on the right, consists primarily of dark red and brown hues with some blue and light brown interwoven in a diagonal pattern. The braided border at the bottom features repeated interlacing strands in various colors, including blue, red, brown, tan, and muted green. The entire composition is centered on a slightly yellowed, aged-looking background with spots and marks around the edges, indicating wear.
title: Shaker Rug
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
